title: Woman dies in custody at Alberta RCMP detachment
article: An autopsy could not determine what caused a woman to die Sunday while she was in custody at the RCMP detachment in Assumption, Alta.
Charlene Danais, 28, was found in the police cell unconscious and not breathing. She was taken to hospital in High Level, where she was pronounced dead.
The results of toxicology testing performed during Monday's autopsy will not be available for several months.
The RCMP Major Crimes Unit is continuing an investigation into the death. The Alberta Serious Incident Response Team was contacted but is no longer involved in the probe.
